primary_author_dissertation.location: Chapter 6 introduction identifies the 2019 article; Section 6.2, printed page 96.
primary_author_dissertation.review_basis: Indexed primary dissertation text from the university repository; direct PDF access returned HTTP 400/429. No local PDF hash or visual inspection is claimed.

supported_measurements.retention: Pressure-plate volumetric water on undisturbed 54-mm diameter, 30-mm high soil cores at -10/-33/-1500 kPa.
supported_measurements.bulk_density: Distinct undisturbed 54-mm diameter, 60-mm high soil cores.
supported_measurements.texture: Sieve sand and pipette silt/clay; existing reviewed sand fraction 0.05-2 mm and fine-earth mass denominator retained.

decisions: All eleven retention outputs describe bulk soil volume, material soil; they are not prepared fine-earth retention measurements.
Fine-earth descriptors belong to analytical texture/carbon aliquots, separately from undisturbed retention and density cores.
Input screening retains reported marginal calibration ranges; these do not prove joint applicability or transferable predictive accuracy.
Density core geometry is explicit and cannot be replaced with a generic volumetric-ring method without evidence.
Eight additional functions acquire complete descriptors. Regression expressions, verification cases and statuses remain unchanged.
The existing g/cm3 source spelling is registered as an equivalent gram_per_cubic_centimeter notation.
remaining: HYBRAS sand sieving/dispersion and fine-earth preparation need per-source confirmation.
Sets 2-4 require matched silt, density-core and carbon methods; generic labels are insufficient.
A bulk-soil target overlay must preserve method and source provenance before scoring.
Cross-Sri-Lanka claims do not establish validity in Brazil or authorize ignoring input support.
